hover.prompt: Very soft short tick of a small metal toggle being touched on a 1940s military radio panel, tiny and dry, close up, no music, no voice

click.prompt: Crisp heavy click of a bakelite and steel switch on a World War 2 field radio panel, short and dry, close up, no music, no voice

confirm.prompt: Solid mechanical clunk of a heavy steel lever locking into place on World War 2 military equipment, followed by a short low metallic ring, close up, no music, no voice

back.prompt: Short muted thump of a steel switch being flipped back off on an old military control panel, slightly lower and softer, close up, no music, no voice

toggle.prompt: Quick ratcheting click of a rotary selector knob turning one notch on a 1940s military radio, close up, no music, no voice

tick.prompt: Tiny single detent click of a calibrated dial turning on vintage military radio equipment, very short, close up, no music, no voice

type.prompt: Single key strike of a 1940s mechanical typewriter, a short crisp clack, close up, no music, no voice

deny.prompt: Short dull double buzz of an old military field telephone rejecting a call, low and brief, close up, no music, no voice

transition.prompt: Short low whoosh of a heavy canvas map sliding across a wooden command table with a faint radio static crackle, about one second, close up, no music, no voice

deploy.prompt: Dramatic start of a World War 2 battle: a crackle of field radio static, a sharp snare drum roll, and a distant artillery boom rolling across the hills, no music, no voice
